deviation: The draft keeps New York law but adds a mandatory executive escalation step before litigation, which delays court access and isn't in the standard. It also broadens venue from New York County courts to any state or federal court "located in New York" (which could mean anywhere in the state), and the venue is no longer tied to New York County.
suggested_text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of New York. The courts at New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.
